meta.name: ontology-database
meta.description: Typed knowledge graph via TSV append-only log — entity CRUD, directed relations, schema validation, multi-hop reasoning. CLI via `x ondb`, protocol readable by AWK/Python/JS/SQLite.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用TSV日志构建类型化知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在命令行下管理实体关系并支持多跳推理
copy.tagline_en: Build typed knowledge graphs via TSV append-only log
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage entity relations via CLI with multi-hop reasoning

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你管理一个知识图谱：添加、修改、删除实体（如人、任务），建立实体间的有向关系，并按类型或属性查询。所有操作都追加到 TSV 日志文件中，不会覆盖已有数据。
howto.when: 当你需要记录实体及其关系，或进行结构化查询时，可以要求 Claude 使用 ondb 命令。例如，管理项目任务、人员信息等。

say.text: 查询所有状态为 open 的 Task。
为项目 proj_001 添加一个 has_task 关系到任务 t1。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you manage a knowledge graph: add, modify, delete entities (e.g., people, tasks), create directed relations between entities, and query by type or property. All operations append to a TSV log file without overwriting existing data.
howto.when_en: When you need to record entities and their relations, or perform structured queries, you can ask Claude to use ondb commands. For example, managing project tasks, personnel information, etc.

say_en.text: Add a Task entity named "Fix login bug" with priority high.
say_en.note: Claude will run `x ondb add --type Task --name "Fix login bug" priority=high`.

say_en.text: Query all Tasks with status open.
say_en.note: Claude will run `x ondb query --type Task --where status=open --json`.

say_en.text: Link project proj_001 to task t1 with relation has_task.
say_en.note: Claude will run `x ondb link --from proj_001 --rel has_task --to t1`.
